summary: A shared LIVE merchant account sends foreign Checkout events to Memocasting; scope correctly signed events without retries or cross-store writes while retaining strict checks for own malformed sessions
evidence: Authorized website deployment owner verified actual MB account is shared with other applications and destination receives all subscribed account Checkout events,2026-10-15
Current StripeCheckoutAdapter.verifyEvent throws stripe_metadata_invalid on foreign no-metadata sessions and HTTP throws stripe_store_mismatch on another store_id
Current orders hold checkout_id,order_id,client_reference_id and payment_id associations available for read-only ownership checks
rollback: Scoped source revert; no destination activation, actual payment or provider data mutation. Historical events and account credentials unchanged.
